scripts.prebuild: sh -c 'if [ "$SKIP_DEPS" = "1" ]; then echo "Skipping build:deps (SKIP_DEPS=1)"; else npm --prefix ../.. run build:deps; fi'
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --ext ts --exec "npm run build && node ./scripts/node-start.js"
scripts.dev:worker: nodemon --watch src --ext ts --exec "npm run build && node dist/worker-entry.js"
scripts.migrate: mkdir -p dist && rm -rf dist/migrations dist/seeds && npx tsc --project tsconfig.migrations.json && node dist/scripts/runMigrationsWithChecksum.js
scripts.migrate:rollback: rm -rf dist/migrations && npx tsc --project tsconfig.migrations.json && DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=../../.env npx knex --knexfile knexfile.cjs migrate:rollback
